def.brief: Local repository hygiene, NEW work by this run. dwitbuk's runtime lock .dwitbuk/review.lock was tracked by the previous run's close commit 86fa350. Confirmed before acting: it is the ReviewLock coordination file (dwitbuk 1.16.0: opened 'a+b' and held by fcntl.flock; 'Never unlink the lock inode; process exit releases it'); it is empty on disk (0 bytes, inode 17328655) and in git (the empty blob e69de29); no process held it. Do: 'git rm --cached .dwitbuk/review.lock' (index only: the file and its inode stay on disk, no unlink and no recreate), and add the exact ignore line '.dwitbuk/review.lock' to .gitignore. No broader rule: reviews/ and any other .dwitbuk/ record stay trackable. reviews/review-20261030-155017-bab4.json and every review artifact are preserved untouched. No sibling engine edit. Limits: this stops the lock being tracked from here on; it does not remove it from history (86fa350 still has it), does not fix or touch the historical private-path record in 9d458a2 and does not claim to, and does not stop a later dwitbuk on Windows from writing its 1-byte lock (now ignored).
checks: import os, subprocess, sys; st = os.stat('.dwitbuk/review.lock'); tracked = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-files', '--error-unmatch', '.dwitbuk/review.lock'], capture_output=True).returncode == 0; print('review.lock on disk: inode', st.st_ino, 'size', st.st_size, '(same inode as before: %s)' % (st.st_ino == 17328655), '| still in the index:', tracked); sys.exit(0 if st.st_ino == 17328655 and st.st_size == 0 and not tracked else 1)

import subprocess, sys; v = subprocess.run(['git', 'check-ignore', '-v', '.dwitbuk/review.lock'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(); rule = v.split(chr(9))[0].rsplit(':', 1)[-1] if v else None; exact = '.dwitbuk/review.lock' in [l.strip() for l in open('.gitignore')]; w = subprocess.run(['git', 'check-ignore', 'reviews/review-20261030-155017-bab4.json', '.dwitbuk/other-record.json', 'reviews/new.json'], capture_output=True, text=True); wider = w.stdout.split() if w.returncode in (0, 1) else ['check-ignore failed']; print('ignored by rule:', rule, '| exact line present:', exact, '| reviews/ or other .dwitbuk/ paths ignored too:', wider); sys.exit(0 if rule == '.dwitbuk/review.lock' and exact and not wider else 1)

import subprocess, sys; t = 'reviews/review-20261030-155017-bab4.json' in subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-files', 'reviews'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split(); same = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--quiet', 'HEAD', '--', 'reviews/review-20261030-155017-bab4.json']).returncode == 0 and subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--quiet', 'HEAD', '--', 'reviews']).returncode == 0; print('prior review JSON still tracked:', t, '| unchanged, nothing staged under reviews/:', same); sys.exit(0 if t and same else 1)

import subprocess, sys; s = sorted(l for l in subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--name-status', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split(chr(10)) if l); g = [l for l in subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '-U0', 'HEAD', '--', '.gitignore'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split(chr(10)) if l and l[0] in '+-' and not l.startswith(('+++', '---'))]; c = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True).returncode; print('staged:', s, '| .gitignore lines changed:', g, '| diff --check exit', c); sys.exit(0 if s == ['D' + chr(9) + '.dwitbuk/review.lock', 'M' + chr(9) + '.gitignore'] and g == ['+.dwitbuk/review.lock'] and c == 0 else 1)

self-performed.why: an index-only removal and a one-line ignore rule, whose risk is touching a live lock inode; the session does it with checks that pin the inode, rather than hand a worker a git index change
